source: Specification v0.9 combat, conditions, MVP damage, death and portable serialization; accepted D07, D09, D10, D14, D19

checks.requirement: clamps hit, effect and escape chances at specified boundaries
testNames: clamps hit, effect and escape chances at specified boundaries

testNames: validates attack identity, target shape and on-board ground targets transactionally
